response.query: Which LCA system boundary will we commit to (cradle-to-gate vs gate-to-consumer), what allocation rules and LUC treatment will we apply, and which exact ecoinvent v3.8 datasets/unit processes will we use?
response.answer: We will commit to cradle-to-gate LCA boundary, apply system expansion allocation rules, and treat LUC as avoided impact. We will use ecoinvent v3.8 datasets for concrete production and transportation processes.
